writing_rules: The only calls to action are to read the guide, or to save or share the post. No "register", "deposit", "claim", "play now", no bonus or offer, no operator name: not in the text, the image text, the hashtags or the alt text. Not even a bonus guide's example amounts: talk about how a term works.
Never glamorise winning or present gambling as a way to earn money.
art_rules: NO real casino interface or slot screen, NO chips or cash as the main subject. Neutral and calm: never depict winning, money raining or euphoria.
review_rules: Any real operator logo or name, fake casino interface or screenshot, invented bonus number or offer, call to register or deposit, or glamorised winning is a failure. The mark 18+ must be on every image.
